supplemental_rows.topic: constructed-language scholarship as a literature in two languages — an English-language argument that language construction teaches linguistic analysis, and a Russian-language monograph's taxonomy of artificial languages, its separation of вымышленные языки from auxiliary languages, its volume rule, and its account of which conlangs left their fictions

the content behind the classification the base could only name — purpose-first typologies in Russian- and English-language scholarship, the a priori/a posteriori dichotomy argued down to a scale, and the design of one conlang-construction course as a companion article reports it.
